verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects lets you create tasks as issues or draft issues and assign them to teammates: assignee changes sync to the issue, and you can reassign by dragging items between assignee groups. Due dates are only implied, through generic custom fields, a week-by-week iteration field and a timeline roadmap view; no date or due-date field is explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a date/due-date field on items, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: The following example will add a draft issue to your project.

An iteration field to plan work week-by-week, including support for breaks.
